definitions.explanation: A person's educational and work history. Used for resumes and formal records.
A chronological record of events, actions, or changes. Common in computing for browser history, transaction logs, etc.

examples.japanese: {履歴書|りれきしょ}を{書|か}く。
{学歴|がくれき}と{職歴|しょくれき}を{履歴|りれき}に{書|か}く。
examples.english: Write your educational and work history in your resume.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{履歴|りれき}は{立派|りっぱ}だが、{人柄|ひとがら}も{見|み}なければならない。
examples.english: His background is impressive, but we also need to look at his character.

examples.japanese: {閲覧|えつらん}{履歴|りれき}を{消|け}す。
{検索|けんさく}{履歴|りれき}から{過去|かこ}の{検索|けんさく}を{確認|かくにん}できる。
examples.english: You can check past searches from the search history.

examples.japanese: {取引|とりひき}{履歴|りれき}を{確認|かくにん}したところ、{不正|ふせい}なアクセスが{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: When I checked the transaction history, I found unauthorized access.

notes:
{履歴|りれき} refers to historical records, whether personal or digital.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {履歴書|りれきしょ} (resume, CV)
- {閲覧|えつらん}{履歴|りれき} (browsing history)
- {検索|けんさく}{履歴|りれき} (search history)
- {更新|こうしん}{履歴|りれき} (update history)
- {取引|とりひき}{履歴|りれき} (transaction history)

USAGE NOTE: In computing contexts, {履歴|りれき} is the standard term for "history" (browser history, command history, etc.).
